articles.summary: Palitronica Inc., the Canadian innovator in physics-based hardware/firmware cybersecurity and quality assurance for safety-critical manufacturing and defense infrastructure, today announced the successful closing of its Series A financing round led by the Business Development Bank of Canada (BDC)’s Industrial Innovation Venture Fund, with participation from Three Kings Capital, Frostbite, and Unpopular Ventures.
